story_world: The newly created world and Gan Eden: soft rolling green hills, clear rivers, fruit trees and flowers, gentle friendly animals, warm golden light. Adam and Chava wear simple, modest, full-coverage tunics. Hashem is never shown as a figure, only as light.

back.objective: Hashem made a beautiful world for us
back.say:
**At the very beginning, there was nothing at all. Just dark.** [Everyone cover your eyes]
**Then Hashem said, "Let there be light!"** [Open your eyes: WOW!]
**This week we'll see everything Hashem made.**

ask.text: What do you see in this picture?
What do you think Hashem made next?
